info.title: SOYL Academy Learning Platform API
info.description: Called by the web tier through the same-origin proxy at /api/platform (ADR-005). Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json. Auth is a session cookie (__Host-soyl_session). State-changing requests need an allow-listed Origin and Content-Type: application/json.

methods.description: Enabled sign-in methods, in display order

enum: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

SchoolInput.description: A school. Shown only to accounts whose consent is granted (D-014).

SchoolSearchInput.description: At most 20 schools, best match first (name starts with the query, verified first).

SchoolCreateInput.description: Find-or-create by normalised name + city (an existing school with the same name in the same city is reused). Names must not contain emails, links, handles, phone numbers or blocked words.

SchoolStatusInput.description: set: a school is saved; not_set: none yet (the UI may prompt); consent_required: consent is not granted, so no school can be saved or shown (D-014).

PatchMeInput.description: API-8: only these fields; role, status, xp, schoolId, city etc. are rejected (400). A school is saved through `school`, and only with consent granted (D-014).

flow.description: builtin = age band + parent code here; external = POST /v1/me/consent/start; none = no consent system yet.
builtin = age band + parent code here; external = POST /v1/me/consent/start; none = no consent system yet.

SchoolAssessmentInput.description: Only when boardAssessed is false: assessed by the school, not in the board exam. periodic = periodic assessment only; project = project work only; practical = practical; internal = formative/internal assessment.

ReviewStatusInput.description: beta = published after automated checks; reviewed = human-reviewed (CONTEXT §4).

StudentQuestionInput.description: A question without its answer, solution or marking scheme (DB-6). Check answers with POST /v1/practice/answers.

ChapterHubInput.description: Public and cacheable; your own progress is GET /v1/me/progress/chapters/{id}.

StreakInput.description: IST calendar days; one missed day per week is covered automatically.

enum: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

MyActivityInput.description: Daily learning activity for a LeetCode-style heatmap. Days are IST calendar days.

ChapterEvidenceInput.description: Inputs of the mastery formula (@soyl/shared/learning/mastery chapterMastery).

DifficultyBandInput.description: Content difficulty 1–2 easy, 3 medium, 4–5 hard (config DIFFICULTY_BAND_LEVELS).

PracticeStatusInput.description: new: never answered; attempted: answered, never right; solved: auto-checked right or self-marked full marks at least once.

PracticeSummaryInput.description: Whole-chapter counts for a LeetCode-style header; `solved` and `byStatus` are null for guests.

MyPlayerCardInput.description: Your private player card. Deterministic from your own learning data; never shown to anyone else.

PracticePartResponseInput.description: mcq/assertion-reason/true-false/multi-select → option_ids; numerical → value; fill-blank → blanks (in stem order); match → pairs; ordering → order (all ids); code-output → output; short/long/writing/map → text.

PracticeResponseInput.description: case-based/source-based → parts (one per child; `alternative` picks an internal-choice alternative).

AnswerKeyInput.description: Revealed only after answering (F-006). `answer` has the content contract Answer shape.

SolvedByDifficultyInput.description: LeetCode-style solved / total per difficulty band (1–2 easy, 3 medium, 4–5 hard).

RecentEventInput.description: A practice event groups one chapter’s answers on one IST day (`at` = the last answer).

NextBadgeInput.description: The unearned badge closest to being earned (streak badges count the current streak).

WeeklyGoalInput.description: questions_solved: practice questions first solved this IST week (Monday–Sunday).

MyDashboardInput.description: Your progress dashboard. Days and weeks are IST (Monday start). Level, XP and coins: GET /v1/me/card; streak and heatmap: GET /v1/me/activity; per-subject chapter levels: GET /v1/me/mastery.

MfaEnrollmentInput.description: Show the URI as a QR code (and the secret for manual entry). Nothing here is stored in the browser.

MfaRecoveryCodesInput.description: Shown once. Each code works once.

MyTestStatusInput.description: Signed in only (null for guests): your attempts at this test, across its versions.

LivePhaseInput.description: live = you can start (until lateStartUntil); writing = running, no new starts; closed = awaiting final ranks.

LiveEventDetailInput.description: Signed in: me is your registration, attempt and result; null for guests.

TestMetaInput.description: Metadata only: questions are delivered inside an attempt.

CustomTestInput.description: skippedChapters: chosen chapters with no matching questions.

StartAttemptRequestInput.description: start=false creates the attempt without starting the clock (instructions / live waiting room).

AttemptStateInput.description: Questions without answers (DB-6/API-9). serverNow + deadlineAt drive the timer (AC-12).

SaveResponsesResultInput.description: Drop queued entries that are applied, stale or rejected; retry only on network/5xx/429.

review.description: S6-H01: a live-mock attempt is score-only until the event closes (after_event): sections, topics, byDifficulty, sectionsLayout and items are empty, self- and AI evaluation return 409 results_after_event.

AttemptResultInput.description: After submission only. Percentile and ranks use auto-graded marks (AC-14).

SelfEvaluationRequestInput.description: Per item exactly one of: marks (total of its written parts), steps (marks per marking-scheme step), parts (case-based: marks per written part).

LiveLeaderboardInput.description: Auto-graded marks only; ties on marks are broken by time taken. Ranks are beta.

AiJobInput.description: evaluation result: {attemptId, evaluated[], notEvaluated[{itemId, reason}], creditsCharged, creditsRefunded, countsForRanks:false}. paper_from_upload result: {blueprint {durationMin, totalMarks, sections[{id, questionType, count, marksEach, internalChoice}], chapterIds}, testId, skippedChapters, creditsCharged}.

CreditsInput.description: Today’s AI credits (1 credit = ₹0.10 of AI). Resets at 00:00 IST; no rollover.

AiQuoteInput.description: Show the cost before the student confirms (CONTEXT §6).

AiUploadTargetInput.description: PUT the file to uploadUrl with these headers within uploadExpiresAt, then POST /v1/ai/uploads/:id/complete.

LeagueTierInput.description: level 1 = the lowest tier; names and icons from LEAGUE_TIERS (shared/config/gamification.ts).

LeagueZoneInput.description: Where the place would finish if the week ended now. Promotion needs at least minXpToPromote XP.

status.description: active = placed in a league; class_required = set board and class first (PATCH /v1/me); students_only = parent/staff accounts do not play.

LeagueCurrentInput.description: Your weekly league (IST week). XP is what each student earned this week. Consent-gated (D-014).

InvoiceInput.description: An invoice (type tax_invoice; titled "Invoice" while the seller is not GST-registered) or a credit note.

PlansResponseInput.description: Plans and INR prices from platform/shared/config/plans.ts (GST-inclusive when pricesIncludeGst).

placeOfSupply.description: GST state code of the buyer (place of supply). Default: the seller state.
GST state code of the buyer (place of supply). Default: the seller state.

SubscriptionCheckoutInput.description: Razorpay Checkout options: { key: keyId, subscription_id: subscriptionId, name, description }. Completing Checkout does not grant the plan; poll GET /v1/me/subscription (after POST /v1/billing/refresh).

OrderCheckoutInput.description: Razorpay Checkout options: { key: keyId, order_id: orderId, amount: amountPaise, currency, name, description }.

get.summary: Liveness
Readiness: database and key-value store
Enabled sign-in methods (the login sheet hides the others)

post.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS (+91 mobiles only)
Verify an SMS code and sign in (creates the account on first use)
Send a sign-in code by email
Verify an email code and sign in (creates the account on first use)

get.summary: Start Google sign-in (302 to Google). intent=link adds Google to the signed-in account (fresh session).

302.description: Redirect to the Google authorization endpoint

get.summary: Google redirect target. Signs in (or links) and 302s to the validated returnTo; failures add ?authError=<reason>.

302.description: Redirect back to the web app

post.summary: Sign out: deletes the session and sends Clear-Site-Data: "cookies"
Send a code to a phone number to add it to your account
Verify the code and add the phone number to your account
Send a code to an email address to add it to your account
Verify the code and add the email address to your account
Remove a sign-in method (never the last one)

get.summary: Current session (guest when not signed in)
Your profile, consent state and sign-in methods

delete.summary: Delete your account: personal data is removed now, the rest is purged within 30 days. Needs a fresh sign-in.

post.summary: Merge guest progress (localStorage soyl_guest_v1) into the account. Once per account; replays return alreadyMerged.
Start (or resume) the parental-consent flow
Pick a new random public name (the auto-generated name shown on leaderboards; real names never are)

get.summary: Your active sessions
Your consent state and which consent flow applies (D-039)

post.summary: Declare your age group. 18 or older (with agree: true) turns consent-gated features on; under 18 needs a parent.
Under 18: email a one-time approval code to your parent or guardian (rate-limited per account, parent email and IP).
Enter the approval code your parent gave you. Single use; replays after approval return the granted state.
Withdraw consent (or cancel a pending request). Gated features switch off and AI conversations and uploads are deleted.
The parent's link: withdraw approval, or decline a pending request. No sign-in; it can only switch features off. Idempotent.

get.summary: Boards and their classes
Subjects for a board and class
Chapters (with topics) of a subject, in board order
Chapter hub: chapter, subject and the published lesson, notes, flashcards, practice and tests with counts
Lesson slides for one deck part (default: the first). Check-slide questions come without answers.
Chapter notes
Chapter flashcards
Practice questions of a chapter (stems and options only), paged, with difficulty bands, your status per question and whole-chapter counts. Signed in: questions you have not answered come first.

post.summary: Check a practice answer on the server. Returns correctness, the answer, solution and marking scheme. Guests are checked but not stored.

patch.summary: Self-assess the written parts of one of your practice answers against the marking scheme

get.summary: Your XP, level, streak and per-chapter lesson and practice progress
Your progress in one chapter (the private half of the chapter hub)

put.summary: Save your lesson position or completion (idempotent)

get.summary: Badges you can earn and the ones you have
Your daily learning activity (IST days) for a heatmap, with streaks and active days
Your mastery level per chapter (not started → mastered) and per subject
Your private player card: overall rating, tier and attributes (deterministic, explained)
Your progress dashboard: totals, solved by difficulty, mastery levels, test history, focus areas, recent activity, next badge and weekly goal (IST days, Monday weeks)
Find your school by name (prefix of any word) and optional city; at most 20. Consent must be granted (D-014).

post.summary: Report a mistake in a lesson, notes, flashcard or question, or a bad AI answer (contentType ai_answer, members only)

get.summary: Your two-step verification status (staff)

post.summary: Start setting up an authenticator app (staff; fresh sign-in)
Confirm the authenticator with a first code; returns one-time recovery codes
Verify this session with an authenticator code or a recovery code
Turn off the authenticator (fresh, verified session and a current code)

get.summary: Content reports queue (staff, two-step verified session)
Test series of a subject: chapter, unit, term, full-mock and second-exam tests, and live mocks. Signed in: your status per test.
Test metadata: sections, duration, marks, instructions. Questions are only delivered inside an attempt.

post.summary: Build a custom test from the practice question bank (free). Then start it with POST /v1/tests/:id/attempts.
Create or resume your single active attempt. Starting sets the server deadline and delivers the paper (no answers).

get.summary: Resume an attempt: the paper, your saved responses, server time and deadline.

put.summary: Autosave a batch of item states. Idempotent per item: a state applies only if its seq is higher than the stored one.

post.summary: Submit (idempotent). An optional final batch is saved first. Objective items are graded now; written items wait for self-evaluation.

get.summary: Result of a submitted attempt: scores, analysis, every answer with its solution and marking scheme, percentile, live rank.

post.summary: Self-evaluate written answers against the marking scheme (free). Returns the updated result.

AI evaluation of written answers (credits: 6 per answer, at most 40 per paper; quote first with GET /v1/ai/quote/evaluate-paper?attemptId=). Body {itemIds?}: one id = evaluate-answer, none/several = evaluate-paper. 202 with a job id; marks never count for scores or ranks.

get.summary: AI marks of your submitted attempt, per item, with step marks and confidence. Never used for scores, percentiles or ranks.
Your attempts, newest first (cursor = the last id of the previous page).
All-India live mocks with their windows and phase. Signed in: your registration and attempt.
One live mock: phase timeline, registration window, rank availability. Signed in: your registration, attempt and result.

post.summary: Register for a live mock (idempotent). Starting the test also registers you.

get.summary: Live mock leaderboard: provisional during the event, final once ranks are published. Needs consent (D-014).
Your weekly league: tier, division standings (auto-generated public names), promotion and relegation zones. Needs consent (D-014).
Plans and prices (INR)

post.summary: Start a Plus/Pro subscription (returns Razorpay Checkout parameters)
Buy the Board Exam Pass (returns Razorpay Checkout parameters)
Cancel the subscription (a paid period runs to its end)
Re-check open purchases with Razorpay (call after Checkout; takes no payment data)

get.summary: The plan in force and the subscription status
My invoices and credit notes (newest first)
Download one of my invoices or credit notes (application/pdf)
Invoices and credit notes issued between two IST dates (inclusive)
The same documents as CSV for the accountant (GSTR-1 style columns)

post.summary: Email an invoice or credit note to the buyer again

get.summary: Today’s AI credits: balance, plan, reset time (00:00 IST) and prices.
Credit history, newest first (cursor = last id of the previous page).
What an AI action will cost, before the student confirms. Evaluate-paper: pass attemptId to price the actual answers.

post.summary: Run an AI action. Stream actions (quick-doubt, explain-slide, hard-doubt, photo-doubt) answer with Server-Sent Events; job actions (evaluate-answer, evaluate-paper, paper-from-upload) answer 202 with a job id. Optional Idempotency-Key header (retries never charge twice).

200.description: text/event-stream. Events: `meta` {requestId, conversationId, action, credits, balance, tier, degraded, mode: hint|full|explain, language: english|hinglish|hindi}; `delta` {text} (moderated chunks, Markdown); `refusal` {kind: unsafe|off_topic|self_harm|output_blocked, message, creditsRefunded, balance}; `error` {code: ai_unavailable|ai_failed|ai_interrupted, message, creditsRefunded|creditsCharged, balance}; `done` {status, creditsCharged, balance, sources?}.

schema.description: text/event-stream. Events: `meta` {requestId, conversationId, action, credits, balance, tier, degraded, mode: hint|full|explain, language: english|hinglish|hindi}; `delta` {text} (moderated chunks, Markdown); `refusal` {kind: unsafe|off_topic|self_harm|output_blocked, message, creditsRefunded, balance}; `error` {code: ai_unavailable|ai_failed|ai_interrupted, message, creditsRefunded|creditsCharged, balance}; `done` {status, creditsCharged, balance, sources?}.

get.summary: Status and result of an AI job (yours only).

post.summary: Get a short-lived, write-only upload URL for one photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP) or sample paper (also PDF), ≤ 10 MB. Uploads are deleted after 30 days.
Tell the server the file is uploaded; it is checked and cleaned (metadata removed) before use.

get.summary: Upload status.
Your AI conversations, newest first.

post.summary: Start a conversation (optional: an action without conversationId starts one).

get.summary: A conversation’s messages (kept 30 days).
Your SOYL Coins: balance, today against the daily cap, check-in streak, milestones
Your coin history (earned, redeemed, refunded), newest first

post.summary: Daily check-in (once per IST day; idempotent)

get.summary: Today's daily challenge question for each subject of a board and class (defaults to your profile)
The SOYL store: items, prices, drops and what you can redeem

post.summary: Redeem coins for an item. Digital items are granted at once; merch needs a verified account, parent consent and redemption switched on, then an address.

get.summary: Your redemptions

put.summary: Shipping address for a merch redemption (only after verification, parent consent and redemption are in place)

post.summary: Cancel a merch redemption before approval (coins come back)

put.summary: Equip an owned profile frame or theme (null takes it off)

get.summary: Merch redemptions by status (staff, two-step verified). Addresses only while under review or approved; viewing is audit-logged.

post.summary: Approve a merch redemption after review (the student's consent is re-checked)
Mark an approved merch redemption shipped
Reject a merch redemption: coins are refunded and the address erased
Razorpay webhook (X-Razorpay-Signature over the raw body; X-Razorpay-Event-Id)

servers.description: Same-origin proxy path on the web host
